# TLE fixture

`iss_20261113.tle` is an archived real ISS record obtained from CelesTrak on 2026-11-14 (KST).

- Source: https://celestrak.org/NORAD/elements/gp.php?CATNR=25544&FORMAT=TLE
- Catalog number: 25544
- Epoch: year 2026, day 317.40012392 UTC
- Purpose: reproducible parsing, coordinate, pass-window and UI tests.

This file is **not a current orbital feed**. Use the app's CelesTrak download button for a new prediction, or supply your own current TLE. The test prediction window is fixed to 2026-11-14 09:00 KST for 24 hours.
